description: This header file defines the AccessControl structure within the WPEFramework::Core namespace, providing static methods for managing file ownership and permissions on POSIX systems. The methods include changing ownership, modifying permissions, and applying combined access control settings based on NodeId attributes.

classes.name: AccessControl
classes.description: A utility struct providing static methods for managing file ownership and permissions, encapsulating POSIX-specific system calls.

methods.name: uint32_t OwnerShip(const string & node,const string & userName,const string & groupName)
methods.description: Sets ownership of a file specified by 'node' to the given user and group names, returning error codes indicating success or failure.

methods.name: uint32_t Permission(const string & node,const uint16_t modeFlags)
methods.description: Sets permission mode on a file specified by 'node' based on mode flags, returning error codes indicating success or failure.

methods.name: uint32_t Apply(const Core::NodeId & node)
methods.description: Applies ownership and permission settings to a NodeId, combining ownership change and permission modification based on NodeId properties.
